source.overpass_query: [out:json][timeout:25];(rel(6304295); rel(7418371);); out geom; >; out skel qt;
source.notes: This demo intentionally does not inject coordinates. The real stop coordinates and route geometry must be retrieved from the referenced OSM relations before integration.

required_before_integration: Fetch the full OSM relation members from the live Overpass API for relation 6304295 and 7418371.
Extract all stop nodes and their exact latitude/longitude from the member list.
Extract the real route geometry (polyline) from the relation geometry output.
Validate every stop coordinate is present and not fabricated.
Confirm the outbound and return polylines match the actual OSM relation directions.
Reject the demo if any node, coordinate, or geometry is missing or inconsistent.
